violation_type.title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))
violation_type.short_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards
violation_type.typical_finding: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards in the infant room on multiple  occasions.

finding_variants.text: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards in the infant room on multiple  occasions.
The person in charge in the director's absence, did not comply with standards by not reporting a situation that left a child with an injury.
It was found during the investigation that the director had knowledge of several incidents that placed children at risk and did not ensure that it was reported to Child Care Regulation.

Based on the information obtained from the investigation,   this standard was reviewed and was determined not compliant when the caregivers at the operation did not have a complete understanding of the Minimum Standards to ensure children are being cared for appropriately.
During the investigation, it was determined that caregivers are not supervised appropriately and are not directed to comply with standards.
Based on information received during the investigation the director did not ensure training was given to the caregiver before having unsupervised access to the children.
